name: google-ads
description: Google Ads API: accessible customers, GAQL search and searchStream, campaign/keyword/search-term reports; agent pause/enable and capped budget changes after opt-in, other mutates node only (OAuth or service account)

nodes.title: Campaign performance
nodes.description: Metrics per campaign (id, name, status, channel, budget) for a date range, highest cost first; removed campaigns are left out. Built on search; the GAQL sent is returned as data.query

date_range.description: Relative range in the account time zone (default LAST_30_DAYS)

metrics.description: Metrics (default impressions, clicks, ctr, average_cpc, cost_micros, conversions); cost is in micros

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

daily.description: One row per campaign and day (adds segments.date)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
